item.title: EU reveals plans for undersea cable straight to Greenland — and could bypass the US entirely to connect up the world
item.description: The EU-backed Pan-Arctic Cable would connect Greenland with Europe, with possible extensions through Canada towards Japan and South Korea.

item.title: Data centers are turning to old jet engines as the wait for power grows
item.description: The years-long wait for access to the grid and new turbines is causing data center builders to turn to an unusual, less-efficient and less environmentally friendly solution: once-discarded jet engines.

item.title: Valve is making changes to deal with a ‘significant increase’ in Steam game submissions
item.description: In a new post today, Valve acknowledged that it's seen "a significant increase in submissions for store and page review in recent months" and says it's "running a little behind" by taking "up to 12 business days" for reviews instead of the typical 3-5 days. Indie developers have recently expressed frustrations over lengthy approval times […]

item.title: Younger adults will consult AI before a financial advisor on money problems
item.description: Brits under 45 are more receptive to AI giving financial advice, with 11% preferring discussing money problems with an AI assistant, compared with 9% relying on a financial advisor.

item.title: The 2026 midterm elections could change everything for Trump. Here’s what’s at stake
item.description: Voters are deciding control of Congress today, and the results could dramatically reshape the final two years of President Donald Trump’s second term. The midterm elections have the potential to upend everything from politics, to business, to the stock market. But the person most impacted by Tuesday’s results could be President Donald Trump and determine the course of his final two years in office....
